# signal but whose first-shell architecture (clustered Asp triad + nearby Tyr

# Contract for fold_daemon:
#   - Refold the protein sequence via AF3 WITH a PQQ ligand (SMILES below) at
#     the indicated metal site. AF3 needs the PQQ as an explicit ligand input.
#   - Output the refolded CIF (with LIG_PQQ + metal HETATMs) into the inbox.
#   - PQQ-aware routing in process_inbox.sh will then handle the rest:
#     normalize_af3_cif → protonate_cif → carve_with_pqq (24-atom PQQ at q=-2
#     in QM region) → write_orca_inputs → sbatch.
# PQQ SMILES (pyrroloquinoline quinone, free acid, 24-atom QM region):
#   O=C1C(=O)c2cc(C(=O)O)c3[nH]c(C(=O)O)c(C(=O)O)c3c2N1
#   (charge state: −2 at physiological pH, two carboxylates deprotonated)
# Columns:
#   stem            — UniProt accession + clade tag (matches *_qm/ stem)
#   apo_ddE_kcal    — current ΔΔE without cofactor (apo-cofactor fold)
#   apo_CN          — first-shell donor count (≤2.8 Å) in current carve
#   architecture    — quick description of why we suspect PQQ
#   priority        — high / medium / low (operator triage)
#   added_by        — agent/operator who flagged the entry
#   added_date      — ISO date stamp
#   notes           — free-text rationale

column8: 9-bladed β-propeller WD40 (atypical for PQQ-ADHs which are usually 8-bladed). Apo-cofactor ΔΔE = +17.7 kcal/mol (Ln-preferring, near +20 Ln-evolved threshold). Architecture is textbook PQQ binding: 3 clustered Asp at the floor of the pocket, 2 Tyr aromatics positioned as a stacking face but OH groups pointed away (consistent with π-stack against PQQ pyrroloquinoline ring), LYS38 + MET32 reaching across from distant blades = classic PQQ catalytic/proton-shuttle/redox-tuning machinery. Likely a soil-actinobacterial quinoprotein dehydrogenase orphan. Strong call for PQQ refold + recarve.
